widgets.name: Dashboard Summary
widgets.description: The project management dashboard reveals that while most projects are on track, delays are noted in the 'Infrastructure' category. Resource utilization is high at 95%, and project velocity has improved by 10% due to new agile tools.

widgets.name: Key Insights
widgets.description:
- Most projects are currently on track, but several in the 'Infrastructure' category are seeing delays.
- Resource utilization is peaked at 95% in the Software Development department.
- Project velocity has increased by 10% following the adoption of new agile tools.

widgets.name: Recommendations
widgets.description:
Top Recommendations:
- Address delays in the 'Infrastructure' category to prevent project overruns.
- Monitor resource utilization closely to avoid burnout in the Software Development department.

Recommended Actions:
- Implement regular check-ins for projects in the 'Infrastructure' category.
- Consider hiring additional resources or redistributing tasks to balance workload.
